capability: Compare rival causal explanations for a specified outcome and return a bounded ruling.

contract_version.description: Major version to apply; default 2. Unsupported major fails closed.

outcome.description: The event, state, change, difference, or decision to explain.

scope.description: Analysis unit, period, geography, population, intended decision. Narrows inferred context.

evidence_seeds.description: Leads to assess, not accepted proof. Default [].

constraints.description: Cutoff, permitted sources, access limits, required comparisons. Cannot change outcome.

report.description: Six-section report; required unless blocked before analysis.

rules: outcome fixes the target; scope narrows inferred context; constraints govern method and access but never change outcome; evidence_seeds are leads, not proof.
A material boundary still unknown, or an outcome not identifiable enough to research, returns needs_clarification naming the missing item; never invent it or substitute another outcome.
An unsupported contract_version major fails closed with an error.
evidence_status is required when execution_status is completed and omitted when clarification or blocking happens before evidence assessment.

A completed report uses references/report-template.md with six headings in order: Scope and outcome; Evidence roles and quality; Competing models; Process and counterfactual assessment; Relative ruling; Limitations, residuals, and next evidence. A free-form narrative is invalid.
detail brief may shorten entries but not drop a heading or field label; standard and full mark unavailable or unrun work explicitly; full adds evidence_ledger per references/evidence-ledger.md.
artifacts is [] unless the direct user separately requests a persistent output.
caller_tag is echoed exactly and never controls research.
A caller needing more research makes a new request; it never rewrites the causal comparison itself.

changes.note: Projection of call-contract.md Version 2. Conditional rules (evidence_status when completed, report sections, ledger for full) stay in the prose contract.
Fold prose call-contract rules into rules; drop prose_contract. No behavior change.
